this module: code the checker accepts under the standard's settings

tests: R1: an empty or machine author is MACHINE_CANNOT_REVIEW (C-32.16) before any act is chosen; any other act is REVIEW_UNKNOWN_ACT (C-87.2)
R2: draft needs edit permission; grant and revoke need ownership, no administrator arm; not permitted and not there are one answer, varying only with the act
R3: the draft's refusals, in order
R4: a draft is created under an opaque DRAFT id or edited in place, keeps only publish's fields, and stamps statement_by
R5: a draft's case identity is read from the published record every time; the stated edition and the four sentences
R6: grant's refusals in order, and a grant bound to the draft's case identity at issue
R7: revoke's refusals; a revocation is recorded once and a repeat answers the first, unchanged
R22: every authorship field is the control plane's stamp, never a body's
R29: reviewgrant, reviewcopy and reviewcomment take secretSha from the body only, never the query; bySecret, author and viewer stay query stamps
R4, R6: an opaque id standing in a live row when the module starts is never drawn again, even after a purge deletes the row
R27: when no free opaque id can be minted, draft's new draft and grant answer MINT_EXHAUSTED through record-core's mintExhausted (its R62, C-59.6; C-87.12 retired), naming the id, writing nothing
R5: the four identity sentences, in every answer that prints one (casedraft, casedrafts, reviewcopy, the grant's boundTo), say what the record holds and carry no code
R30: an active administrator sets the approval rule, null turns it off (the default), each set appended with who and when
R31: a named approver who may see the case's project approves one document at its approval digest (K2528); CASE_NOT_AN_APPROVER otherwise; a later document needs a new approval
R32: at start the rule and approvals are registered once with ratification's approval reader (its R50)
R33: reviewCommentsFor lists the comments on a case edition's review copies for the publisher's choice, fenced as R9, writing nothing
R33: registered at start with case-account's registerReviewComments (its R7), once, answering reviewCommentsFor; never with case-authoring
R33: on a host that hands it no case-account, reviewOf registers with the host's one case-account instance (its R12), whose slot it then holds
R33: after publication each member reviewer whose comments were left out is told once; a recipient is not; an unreadable block tells nobody

R19 R44 (G12c): casedrafts with projects answers one list per project, each equal to the single read of that project, a project the viewer may not see and one that does not exist answering the dead answer as the single read does
R19 R44 (G12c): the batch of projects takes a body list as well, repeats an id once, names no project for an empty list, and answers every project dead to a viewer with no standing or none
R19 R44 (G12c): a batch of projects is bounded and says so: the most it takes answers, one more is refused REVIEW_BATCH_TOO_LARGE and nothing is read

R10 R11 (G12c): reviewcopy with drafts answers one copy per draft, each equal to the single read of that draft, a draft the viewer may not see and one that does not exist answering the dead answer as the single read does
R10 R11 (G12c): the batch of drafts takes a body list too, honours limit as the single read does, and answers every draft dead to a viewer with no standing or none
R10 (G12c): a recipient's batch gets her own draft's copy and the dead answer for every other draft, as the single read gives them
R10 R11 (G12c): a batch of drafts is bounded and says so: the most it takes answers, one more is refused REVIEW_BATCH_TOO_LARGE
R42 (G12c, K4208): casedrafts and reviewcopy are declared, each with the key that batches it, and the declarations hold against the ops as the door runs them

R43: sharedDraftsByProject answers 150 projects asked under the plane's variable bound, for a member whose viewer gate binds its own variables, and counts the one shared project as it counts it asked alone
R43: sharedDraftsByProject answers 150 projects for the founder's viewer under the variable bound (the gate's own arguments, one for the founder)
R11: the answer's parts
